seo_title: B2B SEO Migration: Website Redesign Without Traffic Loss
seo_desc: Changing your website? Protect your B2B sales. We execute bulletproof SEO migrations so your redesign doesn't tank your organic traffic on Google.
author_pitch: I've seen companies billing thousands of dollars a day lose 80% of their organic traffic overnight due to a poorly executed redesign. My job is to shield your digital authority before you change platforms, ensuring your new website starts selling from minute one.
title: Redesign panic: Change your website without destroying your Google sales
body:
Have you just launched your new corporate website and your client calls have dropped to zero?

You invest thousands of dollars and months of work into a spectacular redesign or migrating your business to a modern platform. The website looks amazing, but upon publishing it, you disappear from Google. You have broken links, lost your historical authority, and generated hundreds of 404 errors. Every day that passes without the phone ringing, you are burning the digital authority it took years to build and handing your clients over to the competition.

The trap of Aesthetics over Architecture

Many design agencies delete your old website without mapping the URLs that brought you money, prioritizing visuals over technical profitability. An award-winning design that Google cannot crawl is the most expensive way to ruin a profitable business.

Our solution: Defensive Technical Migration Protocol

At LANZA ESTUDIO, we intervene before, during, and after your redesign. We apply SEO engineering to transfer all the strength, links, and rankings from your old website to the new infrastructure seamlessly.

  1. Surgical URL Mapping: We extract and match every old link generating traffic with its equivalent on the new platform using permanent 301 redirects.
  2. Authority and Backlink Rescue: We ensure that external links pointing to your previous domain are not lost, transferring all that power to your new website.
  3. Staging Environment Audit: We review the redesign code on a hidden server before launch to eliminate crawl blocks and speed drops (Core Web Vitals).
  4. Post-Launch Monitoring: We track your traffic in real-time during the critical weeks following the change to instantly detect and correct any indexing anomalies.

The Real Impact on your Digital Transition

  • Total Revenue Protection: You change your corporate image or server without suffering the dreaded sales abyss in the months following the launch.
  • SEO History Transfer: You keep Google's trust in your domain intact, retaining your number one rankings seamlessly.
  • Accelerated Growth: By combining your new optimized architecture with inherited authority, your organic traffic not only maintains itself but skyrockets.
